statement_status.reference: S-0061, the erratum: 'one needs Assertion (4) of Theorem 3.6, whose proof requires that one can find degree p multisections in Proposition 3.5 that are radicial over the base. Without this, one can only conclude that any two supersingular K3 surfaces in characteristic p >= 5 are connected by a sequence of very special degree p correspondences (as in Assertion (3) of Theorem 3.6)' - Assertion (4) is neither re-proved nor disproved
